purpose: Portable learning and work handoff for independent models and isolated testing

suggested_participants.task: Compare current official documentation and source-backed integration methods; provide source URLs, publication/version dates, limitations, and contradictions. Do not claim that any integration was activated.
Inspect the branch and tests, identify one small improvement, add a regression test, make a minimal reversible patch, and report exact test commands/results.
Review the exact diff for regressions, permission errors, privacy leaks, unsafe side effects, missing tests, and rollback gaps. Cite exact files/lines.
Reproduce tests using supplied repository state, record runtime/dependencies and exact output, and label unavailable network/data as UNKNOWN.

handoff_rules: Do not assume models share memory, files, tools, or network access.
Pass the shared learning block and relevant files explicitly to each participant.
Require a receipt from each participant listing inputs actually inspected.
No participant's statement counts as verification without reproducible evidence.
Integrate only reviewed, minimal, reversible changes; run CI against the exact resulting commit.
Do not merge or deploy solely because a model recommends it.
